result.rationale: Verified in diff: addGuests.schema.ts defines `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness refine, and addGuests.handler.ts's uniqueGuests filter only checks `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` plus blacklist — no dedupe within the request array — then `createMany` inserts all rows. Duplicate emails in one request would create duplicate attendee rows, while the client-side refine in AddGuestsDialog.tsx is bypassable. The client enforce client-side check corroborates the intent. Real defect.

judged_text: The server schema `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` omits the uniqueness refine the client enforces (AddGuestsDialog.tsx lines 26-29), and the handler's uniqueGuests filter only removes emails matching existing attendees, never duplicates within the request array. Any authed client calls viewer.bookings.addGuests with guests:['a@x.com','a@x.com'] (bypassing the dialog's refine), createMany inserts two identical attendee rows and sendAddGuestsEmails dispatches two scheduled emails to the same address, corrupting the booking's attendee list.
